### Historical audit — S0176

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/external/fixed_h0/selected/external/bw_0011/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below identify JSONL lines and observation character ranges.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1 [0,6262) | The requested goal was a photograph-matched cleanroom corner: modular blue walls, floor and ceiling, exposed services, a glazed steel cabinet, dandelion wall image and digital screen. The prompt sought distinguishable materials, connected architectural details, an unobstructed composition and matching camera. These are requested features, not verified contents of the unseen reference image or a resulting scene. The fixed runner, rather than the program, was to save and render. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2 [0,2630) | One fresh, read-only CLI session was launched with the image supplied. It failed with exit code 1 after about 19.8 seconds; it records zero tool calls and no observable model-turn count. The actual model is recorded as unknown. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3 [0,550); `scene_error`, line 4 [0,1612) | The runtime reports that the student process exited 1 while `runtime.ask` was awaiting a response. The error points to a stderr file, but its contents are not included. The underlying cause is therefore unknown. |

**Outcome:** A technical interruption is documented, not an established geometric or algorithmic failure. No student program, scene change, successful build, render inspection, revision or final submission is visible. This is not evidence of an empty patch: no patch operation is shown. Autonomous exploration is likewise not visible beyond the attempted session; the record reports no tool calls.

**Scene checks:** Multiple objects, materials and textures, part connections, pose, camera, lighting and render quality were specified as goals, but none can be checked against an output here. The image path alone does not expose its visual contents in this audit. There is no independent visual or geometric validation.

**Teacher input:** No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update or execution appears in this student trajectory. Consequently, neither receipt nor adoption of teacher advice is evidenced.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, distinguish a process exit from a failed reconstruction and inspect the actual error log before diagnosing it. The cleanroom objects and material distinctions are task-specific targets, not demonstrated solutions. Whether the failure arose from infrastructure, model invocation, image handling or another cause remains unresolved; the referenced stderr and any unrecorded external activity are not available here.
